help.zonestatus: State of one zone: type, files, serial, dynamic, next refresh.
help.flush: Empty the resolver cache (of one view when given).
help.flushname: Remove one name from the cache.
help.flushtree: Remove a name and everything below it from the cache.
help.freeze: Suspend dynamic updates and write the journal into the zone file, to edit it by hand.
help.thaw: Reload a frozen zone and accept dynamic updates again.
help.sync: Write the journal of dynamic zones into their files.
help.nta-add: Add a negative trust anchor: validation is skipped for the name until it expires.
help.ha-sync: Fetch every lease from the partner (server-name) into this server.
help.ha-reset: Put the HA state machine back to waiting: the servers synchronize again.
help.statistic-reset-all: Reset every statistic counter of the server.
help.config-reload: Load the configuration file again, dropping changes not written to it.
help.leases-reclaim: Reclaim expired leases now; remove deletes them instead of keeping them expired.
help.dhcp-disable: Stop answering clients (for max-period seconds when given).
